Package edu.cnu.mdi.graphics.toolbar

Class DefaultToolHandler

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.graphics.toolbar.DefaultToolHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
IToolHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
PlotToolHandler
public class DefaultToolHandler extends Object implements IToolHandler
Default tool handler that performs no actions except for panning, printing, and capturing images. It is intended as a base class for custom tool handlers. It can be used like an Adapter.
Author:
heddle

    • createRadArc

      public void createRadArc(GestureContext gc, Point[] vertices)
      Description copied from interface: IToolHandler
      Create a radial arc.

      The expected interpretation of vertices is tool-defined; for a typical radial arc gesture:

      • vertices[0] = center
      • vertices[1] = radius leg endpoint
      • vertices[2] = angle-defining point
      Specified by:
      createRadArc in interface IToolHandler
      Parameters:
      gc - gesture context (non-null)
      vertices - gesture vertices (non-null)
